resolutions.rationale: Typed kind/value positions preserve transport identity; unlike kinds fail closed.
Ordered name/type/value components preserve composite and scalar keys without lossy string coercion.
The existing runtime dataclass remains unchanged; v1 defines the future adapter boundary.
Position, transaction sequence, event sequence, and event ID form a deterministic total order.
Operation/image rules and explicit capabilities quarantine ambiguity rather than guessing.
Historical evidence stays immutable under its producing schema; new bundles use strict v1 records.
Local ready remains a historical oracle while publication requires the exact eight Stage 3 gates.
No historical receipt is rewritten or retroactively held to new fields.
